metadata.name: executor
metadata.description: SolanaMevBot on-chain arbitrage program, V10 instruction

docs: Not an Anchor program: the discriminator is the single opcode byte 61 and the data after the
fixed header is not Borsh. Decoders that stop after the declared args read the header correctly;
encoders must append the tail described on `arbitrage_v10` themselves.

instructions.name: arbitrage_v10
docs: Executes the most profitable route across up to 4 groups, or fails with no profit unless no_failure is set.
Data after the declared args (all little-endian):
if flags bit 0: conversion_account_count u16 (3..=24)
per group: bridge_count u8, direct_count u8, then one u16 account count per pool in the order
intermediate (omitted when bridge_count is 0), bridges, directs. Each count is 3..=24 and covers
the whole pool block, including its program id and quote mint. At most 16 pools per instruction,
the conversion pool included. A direct-only group (bridge_count 0) needs direct_count >= 2;
direct-only and bridged groups cannot be mixed.
Accounts after the declared ones, in order:
if additional_fee_bp > 0: additional fee collector (w), inserted at index 3 before wallet_settlement_account
if use_flashloan: flashloan authority, flashloan vault (w)
if flags bit 0: Q mint, Q token program, wallet Q account (w), then the Q/S conversion pool block
per bridged group: T mint, T token program, wallet T account (w), B mint, B token program,
wallet B account (w), intermediate T/B block, bridge B/Q-or-S blocks, direct T/S blocks
per direct-only group: T mint, T token program, wallet T account (w), direct blocks
Every pool block starts with the DEX program id and the block's quote mint, and lists vaults in
x/quote order regardless of the pool's own mint order.

accounts.name: settlement_mint
docs: S: WSOL or USDC. Profit is measured and fees are taken in this mint.

accounts.name: fee_collector
docs: Program fee token account for the settlement mint.

accounts.name: wallet_settlement_account
docs: Wallet's settlement-mint token account; must exist and be funded unless use_flashloan is set.
Shifts to index 4 when additional_fee_bp > 0.

args.name: minimum_profit
docs: Settlement-mint base units; fees are charged only on profit above this.

args.name: compute_unit_limit
docs: 1..=1_400_000; zero is rejected.

args.name: no_failure
docs: Succeed without trading when no route is profitable.

args.name: additional_fee_bp
docs: Share of profit paid to the additional fee collector, at most 8500.

args.name: trade_size
docs: Fixed input in settlement-mint base units; 0 lets the program size the trade.

args.name: flags
docs: Bit 0: conversion pool present. Bit 1: constant_conversion, price the conversion at spot
(requires bit 0). Other bits must be 0.
